Tajuddin Ahmad: A life for Bangladesh

On the 101st birth anniversary of Tajuddin Ahmad, we remember one of the principal architects of Bangladesh's independence and the country's first prime minister. A statesman of remarkable integrity, political vision, and administrative resolve, Tajuddin guided the provisional government through the Liberation War and helped lay the foundations of a new nation. This collection brings together The Daily Star Slow Reads' articles exploring his life, leadership, ideas, and enduring legacy in Bangladesh's history.
